record.paper_title: Open Problems on Open Algebraic Varieties (Montreal 1994 Problems)
record.original_question: For contractible, acyclic, or Q-acyclic surfaces of log-general type, is the set of possible Eisenbud-Neumann diagrams of the boundaries of their minimal smooth SNC-completions finite?

evidence.quote:
1.6. QUESTION. Is the number of all Eisenbud–Neumann diagrams Γ˘D of the
boundaries D of the minimal smooth SNC–completions of the contractible (resp. acyclic,
resp. Q-acyclic) surfaces of log–general type finite ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A smooth complex algebraic surface $X$ is called Q-acyclic (resp. acyclic, resp. contractible) if $H_i(X;\mathbb{Q})=0$ (resp. $H_i(X;\mathbb{Z})=0$, resp. $X$ is contractible) for all $i>0$. A smooth SNC-completion of $X$ is a smooth projective surface $\bar X$ together with an embedding $X\hookrightarrow \bar X$ such that the boundary divisor $D=\bar X\setminus X$ is a simple normal crossing divisor; the completion is called minimal if no $(-1)$-curve in $D$ can be contracted while preserving the SNC property. The surface $X$ is said to be of log-general type if the logarithmic Kodaira dimension $\bar\kappa(X)=\kappa(\bar X, K_{\bar X}+D)=2$. To the boundary $D$ (a connected configuration of smooth rational curves meeting transversally) one associates its Eisenbud–Neumann splice diagram $\Gamma_D$, which encodes the dual graph of $D$ together with the multiplicities/self-intersection data needed to recover the plumbed boundary 3-manifold up to homeomorphism.

Question: As $X$ varies over all smooth complex contractible (respectively, acyclic; respectively, Q-acyclic) surfaces of log-general type, and $\bar X\supset X$ varies over all minimal smooth SNC-completions of $X$, is the set of Eisenbud–Neumann diagrams $\Gamma_D$ that arise as the diagram of the boundary $D=\bar X\setminus X$ finite?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches did not surface a specific result establishing or refuting finiteness of the set of Eisenbud–Neumann diagrams of boundaries of minimal SNC-completions of contractible/acyclic/Q-acyclic surfaces of log-general type. While significant work exists on Q-acyclic surfaces and their deformations, no source consulted confirms a definitive resolution of this finiteness question.

status_evidence.title: Q-acyclic surfaces and their deformations
status_evidence.snippet: Studies deformations and structure of Q-acyclic surfaces but does not resolve the finiteness of Eisenbud–Neumann diagrams of their SNC boundaries.
status_evidence.claim: Related work on Q-acyclic surfaces does not appear to settle the stated finiteness question.
